Maya (People Ops): Heads up: our retirement vendor (ZeroFee Retirement) sent a notice claiming they will terminate small-plan support on 2023-11-01. Did benefits team see this?
Ravi (Payroll): I just found the email. It mentions a plan termination and a transfer window but no payroll webhook details.
Priya (Benefits): Got it. Vendor doc lists termination 11/01/2023 and a 30-day participant transfer window; they provided trustee-to-trustee forms and a CSV template.
Maya (People Ops): Two quick concerns: 1) ongoing pre-tax + catch-up deferrals, 2) active loan repayments. If transfers are delayed, people could get taxable distributions.
Jordan (Legal): Correct. We must avoid involuntary distributions. Ill review the vendor agreement for notice obligations; if they missed contractual notice we may have recourse to delay.
Ravi (Payroll): Operationally, we stop sending deferrals after payroll processes the plan termination. If termination is 11/01, the next pay run after that date needs remapping. We can do an off-cycle remap but need approvals and time to process.
Priya (Benefits): Vendor accepts e-signed transfer packets and wants batch CSV: `ssn,last4,dob,account_type,transfer_amount`. They require a signed consent per participant for transfers.
Maya (People Ops): Action plan proposal: A) Pause participant-initiated deferral edits for affected plan until we finish mapping. B) Export full active-participant report with loan statuses. C) Draft urgent employee notice with clear instructions. D) Decide whether Redwood will collect signed consents centrally.
Ravi (Payroll): I can export participant file tonight: sample redacted rows: `employee_id,name,last_deferral_amount,loan_balance`
Priya (Benefits): I'll confirm whether successor trustee accepts loan rollovers or forces distributions. If rollovers allowed, provide the trustees intake spec and e-sign guidance.
Jordan (Legal): Ill draft a short consent/acknowledgement blurb and check privacy implications of collecting signed PDFs centrally. Could host an upload portal with retention policy.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: file vendor termination incident in the vendor tracker and tag Legal + Security.
Maya (People Ops): Deadline: we need draft all-employee urgent note by 5pm today. Priya/Ravi/Jordan can you have your pieces by 4pm?
Ravi (Payroll): Export posted at 2:15pm (redacted sample):
```
employee_id,name,last_deferral_amount,loan_balance
10234,REDACTED,400,8000
10321,REDACTED,0,0
10456,REDACTED,300,0
```
Priya (Benefits): Trustee confirmed they accept electronic batch transfers and e-signatures, but still need signed PDF per participant. They also requested DOB for matching.
Maya (People Ops): Good. If employees must sign, central collection helps speed transfers; Jordan to finalize consent text. Ill prepare the urgent note: "Do not change contribution elections for ZeroFee Retirement until we confirm transfers."
Jordan (Legal): Consent blurb drafted and approved for hosting: short paragraph + checkbox consent. Also flagged international tax rules for a few employees; Priya add an FAQ entry.
Priya (Benefits): Uploaded transfer template and draft FAQ into Shared/Benefits/ZeroFee-Exit/. Also compiling list of 50+ catch-up contributors.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Ill send leadership a status update and publish the urgent note company-wide once consent hosting is ready. Keeping this thread as the log. :thumbsup:
